label: Positive exclusion of an admissible pure determination brings a LIMITING_PRINCIPLE_2
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer x and pure determination k, if x's real-determination profile is admissible, k occurs in some admissible profile, and no admissible profile contains x's determinations together with k, then x has one of the three represented limiting principles (LIMITATION_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_REPRESENTED_LIMITING_2: composite, esse other than essence, or a distinct simply prior being). It is the L bridge in the structural sense; it does not say that a mere absence is a limitation.
